_meta.source: Path of the Fool - Michael Tsarion (2013, Unslaved Media)
_meta.notes: All 16 Court Royals sourced directly from text. Queen of Swords: OCR placed upright positive qualities inside the NEGATIVE block; restored to upright. Queen of Disks: OCR printed two NEGATIVE headers; second block is the REVERSED section.

wands.name: Knight of Wands

meta.age_sex: Men aged thirty six and older

Practicality. Resilience. Prolific. Creative. Pioneering. Sports. Competition. Mastery. Victory. Success. A project or adventure begins. The first steps. New avenues explored. Leaving the old behind. wands.reversed: Weakness. Doubt. Hesitation. Prevarication. Premature capitulation. Apathy. Loss of ambition. Shattered intentions. Weak vision. Poor insight. Cowardice. Dishonor. Being bested. Falsity. The mask falls. Lack of self-reliance. Dependency. Low self-esteem. Easily swayed and led. Losses. Poor health. Conflict with a male.
